mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer spending, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% or greater YoY decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of YoY RSAFS decline < -2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% or greater month-over-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals a supply-side expansion that boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of INDPRO > 1% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.5 percentage point rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a 1% month-over-month drop in industrial production (INDPRO) over the same month signals a synchronized labor-supply contraction, which reduces earnings and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND INDPRO falls > 1% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND INDPRO falls > 1% in the same month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 5% or greater month-over-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals a demand-driven acceleration that boosts earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of RSAFS > 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point or greater month-over-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a 1% month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the same month signals a tight labor market coinciding with supply expansion, which raises wage pressure and inflation risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp AND INDPRO rises > 1% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp AND INDPRO rises > 1% in the same month (t-test p > 0.05).
